data.name: Fakhar
data.gender_notes: Fakhar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fakhar is an Arabic name meaning 'pride' or 'honor'. It reflects dignity, prestige, and the feeling of being proud — often used to denote someone of great achievement or noble character. The name Fakhar carries the meaning “Pride, Glory, Dignity” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Fakhar usually hope their child will grow to embody pride, glory, dignity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents honor through character and dignity through actions — a soul that brings pride to family and faith.
data.etymology: Fakhar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pride, Glory, Dignity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fakhar total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: فخر
in_arabic.long_meaning: فخر هو اسم مشتق من الفخر، وهو الشعور بالشرف والاعتزاز بالنفس، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الإسراء آية ٣٢ 'ولا تقف ما ليس لك به علم إن السمع والبصر والفؤاد كل أولئك كان عنه ما كان منه فلا تقف ما ليس لك به علم إن السمع والبصر والفؤاد كل ذلك كان منه فلا تقف' حيث يشير إلى عدم الإفطار في الشهوات المحرمة. و الفخر في اللغة العربية هو اسم يدل على الارتفاع والعلو في الشأن

in_urdu.name: فخر
in_urdu.long_meaning: فخر ایک ایسا نام ہے جو عزت و سربلندی سے جڑا ہوا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے فخر، اعزاز اور خود کی عزت۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے اور اسلامی ثقافت میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ فخر نام کے حامل کو اپنے اعزاز اور فخر کا احساس برقرار رکھنے کی ترغیب دیتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फखर
in_hindi.long_meaning: फखर नाम का अर्थ है फखर, सम्मान और आत्म-सम्मान। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से आया है और इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण है। फखर नाम के व्यक्ति को अपने सम्मान और आत्म-सम्मान का एहसास बनाए रखने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करता है। यह नाम दक्षिण एशियाई मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी लोकप्रिय है और अक्सर बच्चों के नामकरण में चुना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: فخر
in_pashto.long_meaning: فخر د يو نوم څخه مشتق دی چی د عزت او ویاړ معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو ترمنځ مشهور دی او د هغوی په کلتور کې ځانګړی اهمیت لري. فخر نوم د هغه چا لپاره کارول کیږي چی د ویاړ او عزت احساس ولري.

in_english.name: Fakhar
in_english.long_meaning: Fakhar is an Arabic name that means 'pride,' 'honor,' or 'self-respect.' It is derived from the Arabic root 'F-KH-R,' which conveys a sense of elevation and nobility. In Islamic tradition, the name Fakhar is associated with positive attributes such as dignity, self-esteem, and nobility of character. The name has historical significance and is used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing the importance of maintaining one's honor and pride.

data.cultural_impact: Fakhar is a powerful name that represents the cultural values of honor, respect, and pride. In many Muslim communities around the world, it is considered a name for boys of great achievement and nobility. Names have significant cultural importance in many societies, and Fakhar embodies the best qualities of courage, self-respect, and achievement, making it an inspiring name for many parents to choose for their children.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Fakhar carries deep significance as it reminds us of the importance of inner pride, self-love, and dignity before Allah (God). In Islam, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "Allah loves to be mentioned much." Thus, uttering the beautiful name of Allah frequently is considered a source of great spiritual reward. The continuous remembrance of Allah with love and pride in one's heart is seen as a way to preserve one's spiritual connection to Him and represents a virtuous character.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Fakhar: To exalt or magnify Allah with pride and honor, acknowledging His supremacy and greatness. It is a reminder to always keep Allah at the forefront of our hearts and actions.
